units.source_text: 再说，千重子曾多次来过这个村子，看见过男人们把杉树圆木材的树皮粗粗地剥掉之后，

en.t: Besides, Chieko had come to this village many times and had seen the men roughly strip the bark from the cedar logs,

units.source_text: 再由女人仔细地剥一遍，然后用水或温泉水拌和菩提瀑布的沙子，轻轻地洗刷着圆木的情景。

en.t: then the women carefully peel them once more, mix Bodhi Falls sand with water or hot spring water, and gently scrub the logs.

units.source_text: 她还模模糊糊地记得那些姑娘的面孔。

en.t: She still vaguely remembered the faces of those young women.

units.source_text: 那些加工活儿都是在路旁或户外进行的，

en.t: That processing work was all done by the roadside or outdoors,

units.source_text: 而在这小小的山村里，不至于有那么多姑娘。

en.t: and in this small mountain village there could not have been so many young women.

units.source_text: 当然，她也没有把每个姑娘的脸都一一仔细地观察过。

en.t: Of course, she had not carefully studied each young woman's face one by one either.
